Instruction: many arrows and brackets are added, but a correct result needs five unambiguous one-to-one animal-to-pattern connections; the tiger points to the brown scalloped swatch, the lion toward the spotted swatch, and other paths branch or stop without matching. Most required matches fail. Knowledge: the explanation requires matching animal coats; the visible stripe, spot, feather and plain-color associations are not correctly established. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: structural coherence ✘ and artifact-free ✘: overlapping heads, fused bodies, detached fragments and tangled diagram paths create severe semantic and anatomical failures; flat colors and white background remain clean.

Consistency: excluding the requested composition, backdrop and graphics, the gray shoe identity and colored side panel remain recognizable, but lace geometry, collar mesh, black heel-panel detailing and sole contours are visibly redrawn. Instruction: the centered shoe now sits over diagonal white flow tracks with speed streaks on a gray-to-ice-blue gradient, giving the requested modern sports-tech composition; however, the upper-right title reads LIGIRY rather than the required Light Start, so a required aspect is incorrect. Quality: structure ✔, lighting/perspective ✔ and overall artifact-free presentation ✔; the shoe and tracks form a coherent poster with legible headline lettering. Texture fidelity has a minor issue in the rough, irregular mesh and lace junctions near the front of the upper.
